stage_entry.text: 确认开胸位置，开始进入胸腔。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the thoracotomy site and begin entering the chest.

stage_entry.text: 单肺通气参数正在监测，手术侧暴露可以继续。
stage_entry.text_en: One-lung ventilation is being monitored. Exposure on the operative side can proceed.

stage_entry.text: 肺门组织已经进入视野，先辨认支气管与血管分支。
stage_entry.text_en: The pulmonary hilum is in view. Identify the bronchus and vascular branches first.

stage_entry.text: 调整肺叶牵引，保持肺门根部暴露。
stage_entry.text_en: Adjust lobar traction to maintain exposure of the hilar root.

stage_entry.text: 这里是肺动脉分支，分离时保持清楚的血管外膜界面。
stage_entry.text_en: These are pulmonary artery branches. Maintain a clear perivascular plane during dissection.

stage_entry.text: 注意分支与肺叶支气管之间的空间关系。
stage_entry.text_en: Pay attention to the spatial relationship between the branches and the lobar bronchus.

stage_entry.text: 血管控制与缝合器械已经备好。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for vascular control and repair are ready.

precision_failed.text: 这条肺动脉分支的界面不够明确，需要重新辨认。
precision_failed.text_en: The plane around this pulmonary artery branch is not clear enough. Reidentify it.

precision_failed.text: 先调整分离方向，不能在血管边界不清时推进。
precision_failed.text_en: Adjust the dissection direction before advancing along an unclear vessel boundary.

stage_entry.text: 现在分离肺叶支气管周围组织，留意邻近血管。
stage_entry.text_en: We are dissecting the tissue around the lobar bronchus. Watch the adjacent vessels.

stage_entry.text: 先保证支气管上下缘都能看清，再继续分离。
stage_entry.text_en: Ensure both bronchial borders are visible before continuing.

stage_entry.text: 支气管壁的牵拉需要均匀，避免扭转。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep traction on the bronchial wall even and avoid twisting.

precision_failed.text: 支气管周围的组织层次尚未分清，需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The peribronchial tissue planes are not clearly separated. Correct this step.

precision_failed.text: 先撤回这一步，重新确认要保留的支气管边界。
precision_failed.text_en: Step back and reconfirm the bronchial boundary we need to preserve.

stage_entry.text: 复核病变范围与预定切缘，保留结构必须明确。
stage_entry.text_en: Reassess the disease extent and planned margins. The structures to preserve must be clear.

stage_entry.text: 把肺动脉和支气管的重建计划再核对一遍。
stage_entry.text_en: Review the pulmonary artery and bronchial reconstruction plans once more.

stage_entry.text: 进一步确认切缘位置，避免把正常支气管切除得过多。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the margin position without removing more healthy bronchus than necessary.

stage_entry.text: 保留侧组织需要稳定支撑，别影响后续吻合。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the preserved tissue supported to avoid compromising the later anastomosis.

stage_entry.text: 切缘处理和后续吻合的器械已依次备好。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for margin work and the subsequent anastomosis are prepared in sequence.

precision_failed.text: 这一处切缘与计划有偏差，先重新核对。
precision_failed.text_en: This margin differs from the plan. Recheck it first.

precision_failed.text: 保留结构的边界还不理想，需要调整。
precision_failed.text_en: The boundary of the preserved structure is not satisfactory. Adjust it.

stage_entry.text: 准备完成肺叶切除，随后整理支气管重建区域。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to complete the lobectomy, then organize the bronchial reconstruction area.

stage_entry.text: 标本移出后先重新建立稳定的肺门暴露。
stage_entry.text_en: After specimen removal, reestablish stable hilar exposure.

stage_entry.text: 进入支气管袖式吻合，先核对两端口径与方向。
stage_entry.text_en: Begin the bronchial sleeve anastomosis. Check the calibre and orientation of both ends.

stage_entry.text: 保持吻合口张力均匀，避免接口旋转。
stage_entry.text_en: Maintain even anastomotic tension and avoid rotational misalignment.

stage_entry.text: 支气管吻合的细缝线已准备就绪。
stage_entry.text_en: Fine sutures for the bronchial anastomosis are ready.

precision_failed.text: 支气管吻合处的对位不充分，需要重新修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The bronchial anastomosis is not adequately aligned. It needs correction.

precision_failed.text: 这段吻合的张力不理想，先调整再继续。
precision_failed.text_en: The tension across this part of the anastomosis is unsatisfactory. Adjust it before continuing.

stage_entry.text: 接下来复核肺动脉重建段，注意血流通路的方向。
stage_entry.text_en: Next, review the reconstructed pulmonary artery segment and its alignment with the flow path.

stage_entry.text: 血管接口需要保持自然走行，避免扭曲与受压。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the vascular junction in a natural alignment without kinking or compression.

stage_entry.text: 血管吻合用器械及缝线保持待命。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments and sutures for vascular anastomosis remain ready.

precision_failed.text: 血管重建段的接口不够平顺，需要纠正。
precision_failed.text_en: The reconstructed vessel junction is not sufficiently smooth. Correct it.

precision_failed.text: 先别进入复查阶段，这里的血管对位还需调整。
precision_failed.text_en: Do not proceed to reassessment. The vascular alignment needs adjustment.

stage_entry.text: 可以配合进行通气检查，相关监测持续进行。
stage_entry.text_en: We are ready to assist with ventilation testing. Monitoring continues.

stage_entry.text: 依次复查支气管吻合口与肺部灌注状态。
stage_entry.text_en: Review the bronchial anastomosis and pulmonary perfusion in sequence.

stage_entry.text: 再看一遍肺门重建区，确认没有遗漏的渗血。
stage_entry.text_en: Inspect the reconstructed hilar area again for overlooked oozing.

stage_entry.text: 胸腔引流和关闭所需器械已经就位。
stage_entry.text_en: Chest drainage and closure instruments are ready.

stage_entry.text: 关闭前复核器械清点和术中记录。
stage_entry.text_en: Recheck the instrument count and operative record before closure.
